about.title: About the Sheikh
about.placeholder: Sheikh Yousef Al-Fenadi is a Libyan reciter who recites the Holy Quran in the Qaloon 'an Nafi' narration, the narration used in Libya. This khatmah was recorded at Al-Diyar Mosque, Souq al-Jumaa, Tripoli.
bio: Sheikh Yousef Al-Fenadi is a Quran reciter from Libya. He recites in the Qaloon 'an Nafi' narration — the reading adopted in Libyan mushafs and used in its mosques and Quran schools.
This khatmah includes all 114 surahs, recorded during the Ramadan 1447 / 2026 tarawih prayers at Al-Diyar Mosque, Souq al-Jumaa, Tripoli.
All recitations are offered here for listening and free download, retaining the original recording quality without any modification.
To follow new recitations, you can visit the Sheikh's channel on Telegram.
